facts.fact: The National Police Service reports that on 4 September 2025 the Interior Cabinet Secretary restated the ministry's commitment to rolling out a Digital Occurrence Book and a Case Management System with secure mobile applications; both are given as an initiative to be rolled out, with no station said to be using them.
facts.system: Digital Occurrence Book (DOB) and Case Management System

facts.fact: The Ministry of Interior and National Administration is named as committed to digitising police operations, the Digital Occurrence Book and Case Management System included, in the Cabinet Secretary's address to station commanders on 4 September 2025.
